properties.name: spring.ai.structured-output.guard.max-attempts
properties.description: Total attempts including the first call.

properties.name: spring.ai.structured-output.guard.enable-repair
properties.description: Enables lightweight JSON repair before retrying.

properties.name: spring.ai.structured-output.guard.include-last-error-in-retry-prompt
properties.description: Adds the sanitized parse error to retry instructions.

properties.name: spring.ai.structured-output.guard.max-error-message-length
properties.description: Truncates parse errors included in retry prompts.

properties.name: spring.ai.structured-output.guard.retry-on-structured-output-error
properties.description: Retries errors classified as structured-output parsing failures while attempts remain.

properties.name: spring.ai.structured-output.guard.retry-on-other-error
properties.description: Retries errors that are not classified as structured-output parsing failures.

properties.name: spring.ai.structured-output.guard.retry-backoff-millis
properties.description: Fixed wait before each retry; 0 means no wait.

properties.name: spring.ai.structured-output.guard.metrics.enabled
properties.description: Enables the Micrometer listener when a MeterRegistry bean is present.
